title: Image alt text loses escapes and decoded entities
prompt: Image descriptions lose some characters while ordinary inline text keeps them. For example, '![a \* b](/u)' should render with alt text 'a * b', and '![a & b](/u)' should retain the ampersand (escaped once as & in HTML). Mixed emphasized text, escapes and entities inside the same description should remain in order. Repair image description processing while preserving token metadata, emphasis handling, entity escaping and the surrounding inline text. Add regression tests; avoid changing the public renderer contract.

hardness_evidence.criterion: at least 20 meaningful changed production lines across at least two functions
families: escaped punctuation in nested image children
mixed emphasis plus text segment coalescing
